description: Call this tool to turn pages by a multiple of 90 degrees, clockwise for positive. Rotation is added to whatever the page already had, for a sideways scan. Writes a new file. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

degrees.description: 90, 180, 270 or -90. Positive turns clockwise. Added to the page's existing rotation

out_path.description: Name for the rotated PDF; it comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

pages.description: Which pages to turn, e.g. "1" or "2,4-6". Omit for every page

path.description: Name of an uploaded PDF (pdf_upload), or one this server wrote earlier

name: pdf_rotate
title: Rotate pages
